capabilities: (verb) Manage tasks via Kanban and Eisenhower matrix
(verb) Log fitness activities and track progress
(verb) Monitor finances and track net worth
(verb) Log nutrition and search food data
disambiguation: Not just a note-taking app; it is a comprehensive, integrated life management system for Obsidian.
extras: Momentum Pro is a paid one-time unlock for binary file sync; the core functionality is free and open-source.
problem: Users need a centralized, local system within Obsidian to track complex life aspects like habits, finances, and fitness without relying on external, proprietary apps.

relations.evidence: Two-way sync between your Tasks boards and Google Tasks.
Import your watch and phone data into Fitness and Nutrition.

summary: An all-in-one life dashboard for Obsidian that manages habits, tasks, fitness, nutrition, studies, and finances using local Markdown files.
